oracle.independence_basis: The generator enumerates every orientation of the declared skeleton, keeps the acyclic ones whose unshielded colliders equal the CPDAG's (here none), and counts them; the orient and insert cases are evaluated as plain edge-set operations with a depth-first reachability test for the cycle. It imports no Antecedent code and calls no completion or orientation routine. The class definition (acyclic orientations with the same skeleton and unshielded colliders) is the shared theorem; the fixture's no-Meek-propagation reading of 'orient' is a statement of the product operation, not derived.

reference_review.limitations: Three-node motifs only. The orientation case records a raw edge orientation: Meek propagation would additionally orient 1--2 (0->1--2 with 0 and 2 non-adjacent), so the case documents the container operation, not a Markov equivalence class inference. The class size is the only value derived from a definition; the other two cases are operation semantics. Calibration unmeasured.
